name: brand-assets
body: Brand assets: repo-root `brand/` directory holding a hand-authored SVG recreated from the brand-board image (mark plus lowercase Inter wordmark, with the wordmark outlined to paths so no font is needed), PNG exports at 512/128/32/16px rendered from that SVG (palette per brand-identity), and `brand/LICENSE` (all rights reserved, Really Knows AI, plus the trademark statement). No third-party artwork. Referenced only from README.md, package-channel descriptions and an optional GitHub social preview. NOT part of embedded-assets; never go:embed'ed; never referenced from the served page shells; not covered by the root Apache-2.0 LICENSE (see requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded). implemented-by deferred: `brand/*` files do not exist yet — plan declares them as planned file nodes.
